decision.summary: A confirmed temporary offset interval (608–612) is identified: a rapid, multi-axis coherent reversal of the earlier sustained offset (~560–605), with clear onset at 608, sustained interior (609–611), and observable return by 612 on all three components (N, E, U). No other temporary offsets within allowed_context [570,660] meet the criteria of complete onset–interior–return structure.

intervals.observation: Multi-axis coherent downward shift (U: ~20→5, E: ~17→3, N: ~-6→-2) spanning indices 608–612; onset at 608 is sharp and sustained through 612, with all axes returning toward pre-offset levels. Post-612 behavior stabilizes near prior baseline (e.g., U ~5–6, E ~2–4, N ~-2 to 0), consistent with a temporary offset reversal rather than permanent step. Return is observed and coherent across axes.
